$comment: Increment-7 scorer settings (MB-27 increment 7, pulled forward by operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim: "y inc7 early"). Data, no code. Every value marked provisional below is the reading in ~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc7/RESEARCH-20261115.md and waits for the operator's ruling (decision lane drafting); a ruling changes this file, never the scorer. Sources: 69a = docs/specs/01-pipeline/69a_mcbylaw_register.md (M-362 at 498), 68 = docs/specs/01-pipeline/68_mcbylaw_standard.md (SC-19 at 84), CARD = mcbylaws/sources/cards/CARDS-2026-10-29.answered.md (MB-13, CARD-HR), REF = ref/mb15-blind-run reference/mb15/blind-score.mjs.ref (rules read, code not reused). Closeness threshold stays null: it is set from this increment's data and recorded before the proof set is keyed (69a:498).

provisional.direction.gate_measures: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-1: gate = gfa, height, storeys; footprint and units compared and reported, each wrong case a numbered finding.
provisional.direction.threshold_pct: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-2: needed = ceil(0.90 x denominator), written correct*10 >= 9*denominator, each measure separately; 69a:498.
provisional.direction.count_rounding: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-2: ceil, tested as the exact ratio (no printed-precision comparison).
provisional.direction.denominator: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-2: our not-evaluated counts as wrong; a measure is excluded for a case iff the keyed applicant figure is null (a data rule); the excluded list is an output frozen in the manifest.
provisional.direction.tolerance: REF tolerances: gfa 0.05 m2, height 0.05 m, storeys 0. Provisional.
provisional.direction.variance_granted_values: REF counts yes and modified as a variance. Open: Q6.
provisional.closeness.spread: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-3: median plus p25 to p75 by the oracle-compare.mjs:24 quant (index floor(q*(n-1))); closeness is GFA only.
provisional.closeness.population: 69a:498: new-build cases with no GFA variance.
provisional.catch.class_rules: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-4: the six rules (M-364) and the class meanings as data, incl. the second CAUGHT-ESTIMATE trigger, relative limits, off-scope rows (bicycle parking etc.) as data, false-alarm categories, SC-19 wrong limits 0 with complete inputs.
provisional.catch.not_evaluated: 69a:498: not-evaluated counts as missed (class MISSED in the table, in the denominator).
provisional.catch.thresholds: 69a:498 and 68:84 (CAUGHT+CAUGHT-ESTIMATE >= 70, CAUGHT >= 50, false <= 10, soft <= 15, wrong limit <= 3; 0 on existing-lot minimums and existing/party walls).
provisional.buildings: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 1, BUILDING-MAP.md section 6) and Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "3 y" (item 3, by building). The clause-family table, displaced_by rows, duplicate rule and the by-building scoring rules are data in the buildings block.
provisional.catch.wrong_limits: RULED: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md), D-4: SC-19 wrong limits 0 with complete inputs; complete inputs defined by catch.complete_inputs; wrong limits <= 3 with named causes (a row cause).
provisional.buildings.class_map: PROVISIONAL: the applicant type map is not frozen (M-364 rule 6); only golden_p_type values that name a Layer 3 class are mapped, the rest score as not evaluated. Open for the operator at the key step.

six-unit major-street abutment rule not modelled

rulings.building_rule: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 1, BUILDING-MAP.md section 6)
rulings.d1_d4: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "1,2 and 4 y" (item 2, D-1..D-4 with the grounded review fixes, REVIEW-grounded.md)
rulings.primary_measure_by_building: Operator ruling 2026-11-15, verbatim "3 y" (item 3, by building)
rulings.laneway: Operator ruling 2026-11-15: laneway suite held (MB-57); laneway-suite figures score as not evaluated with the disclosure
